name: seenby
description: AI search visibility MCP connector by Seenby: AI visibility tracking for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI answers, with cited pages and answer history.
long_description: AI search visibility tracking for your brand. Seenby asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode and Google AI Overviews the questions your buyers ask and records brand mentions in AI answers: whether your brand is named, its position, the competitors named instead and the pages each answer cites. get_account and get_brand_report read your plan, tracked brands and the action list; get_question_history and list_cited_pages read answer history and cited pages; suggest_setup, create_brand and run_brand_now set up and run tracking within your plan's limits; check_website asks ChatGPT three buyer questions about any website. A free account comes with 5 checks, no card.
